listings.remarks: This adorable single-story home is the one for you! Nestled in a desirable golf-course corner lot, this gem offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a 2-car garage. Inside, you'll discover sizable living areas perfect for entertaining and relaxation, including a formal dining room. The kitchen comes equipped with ample counters, plenty of cabinet space, essential appliances, and a pantry. The main bedroom hosts a walk-in closet for easy organization and a full bathroom for added comfort. The backyard includes a covered patio ideal for enjoying a refreshing drink. Hurry up and check it out!

listings.remarks: TWO PRIMARY SUITES WITH SEPARATE ENTRANCES, NEARLY HALF AN ACRE & NO HOA! This 4-bedroom, 3-bath home sits on a spacious corner lot offering privacy, versatility, and room to spread out. Ideal for multigenerational living or guests, the dual primary suites provide flexible living options. The tri-level, open-concept floor plan features classic wood flooring, a striking wraparound fireplace, French doors, and a charming entryway with brick flower shelving. The gourmet kitchen boasts granite countertops and a stone tile backsplash. Additional highlights include stone tile showers, a spacious laundry room, and a large wet bar perfect for entertaining or a game room. Outside, enjoy mature palm trees, an expansive backyard, and an oversized covered patio.
highlights: Two primary suites, one with a separate entrance

RV access, circular drive and detached workshop
Solar panels and tankless water heater
